response.original_title: Kultsia: The Art of the Apology
response.overview: This work was part of the director's research with her mother, Kultsia-Barbara Wyss, who spent 7 years in the St. Paul's Residential School and went on to spend another 5 years in Day School, through St. Edmonds. Both of these schools were/are in North Vancouver and are at walking distance from where her mother grew up. It is a conversation over tea, about her time at Residential School, and how she witnessed her life from a young girl to her elder hood, and the many challenges she faced as well as endured as a result of attending these schools. It is a legacy piece created for her grandchildren to hear her personal story.
response.title: Kultsia: The Art of the Apology
